Codes: one stable error-code set covers reads and writes, returned as _meta.error_code with IsError and a text line `<code>: ...`: denied, invalid_input, conflict, expired_intent, approval_required, operation_limit, hook_refused, unavailable_provider, incomplete_result, unknown_execution, in_progress (an attempt of the same operation is still running), constraint_failed and invalid_declaration. Unknown internal classes are reported as incomplete_result.

Final failures: constraint_failed means the command's own apply SQL hit a FOREIGN KEY, UNIQUE/PRIMARY KEY, NOT NULL or CHECK constraint; the business transaction rolled back, so it is a known failed attempt (never unknown), and its text names only the constraint kind, never SQL, tables or row values. invalid_declaration means the reviewed command cannot run against this database (a dependency query that does not return exactly one id column, command SQL that calls a function outside the allowed list or one SQLite does not have, or command SQL that names a column the database does not have; the text names the dependency or the function, never a column or a table). Both are final: _status reports retryable false and _commit answers the same code without claiming another attempt, so prepare a new operation after fixing the data or the source. A trigger RAISE, a constraint on a framework table and every other SQL error are unavailable_provider.

Where codes are explained: denied with a reason, expired_intent, approval_required, in_progress, unknown_execution and operation_limit in `connector_commit`; hook_refused in `connector_hooks_effects`; invalid_input messages in `review_page_state` (3); prepare refusals in `connector_commands` and SQL function refusals in `connector_command_sql`; external read failures in `connector_external`; file and artifact failures in `connector_files`, `connector_artifacts` and `html_artifacts`.
